notes: P02 POPETS-X07_privacy_cases deliverable: evaluation/venue2027/popets/privacy_cases.py is the ex-ante FROZEN privacy test-case set (N=9) for RQ1 of 'Revocation-Complete Future Disclosure for Cached Longitudinal AI Contexts', frozen before any candidate arm (B0-B4, C0) executes. Typed frozen dataclasses: CaseScenario (injected ledger + dispatch item + principal/purpose/time query triple, all synthetic structural placeholders, PHI-free) and PrivacyCase (case_id, scenario_class, scenario, expected_semantic_outcome, revocation_model_reference, case_matrix_ref, description). Expected semantic outcomes drawn from ExpectedSemanticOutcome = ALLOW | DENY | INDETERMINATE | OUT_OF_SCOPE | NOT_GUARANTEED: the first three mirror the revocation_model TriDecision vocabulary; OUT_OF_SCOPE (threat precision, POPETS-CASE-06) and NOT_GUARANTEED (memorization uncertainty) are honest guarantee-boundary outcomes carried by the orthogonal RevocationDecision effect fields (already_delivered_effect=OUT_OF_SCOPE_PAST, memorization_guarantee=NOT_GUARANTEED) and are NEVER coerced into verdicts. Five scenario classes, all five outcomes covered: fresh_dispatch PC-FRESH-01/02 (ALLOW, authorized utility incl. scope-local recompute without false invalidation), post_revocation_dispatch PC-REVOKE-01/02 (DENY/DENY_POST_REVOCATION boundary-inclusive at t_r, retry and fallback transport), cross_purpose PC-XPURP-01 (DENY/PURPOSE_NOT_CONSENTED: known-but-unconsented purpose via a second synthetic principal making the purpose string known in ledger vocabulary), transitive_gap PC-TGAP-01/02 (INDETERMINATE/LINEAGE_INDETERMINATE fail-closed: second-order derived node with unlabelled ancestry inside the post-t_r closure, and orphan derived cache), already_delivered PC-DELIV-01/02 (future dispatch still DENY/gated while the pre-t_r delivered copy is OUT_OF_SCOPE_PAST — no retroactive-erasure claim anywhere; authorized dispatch stays ALLOW with memorization honestly NOT_GUARANTEED — never a DENY-as-erasure). Every case maps to a REAL revocation_model.decide() decision over its typed scenario (revocation_model 1.0.0 semantics reference named per case); freeze discipline mirrors pst.forensic_queries and _shared.analysis_policy: canonical-JSON SHA256 freeze constant FROZEN_CASE_SET_SHA256=d48dfcb37af0d998b801101c34ec9a0f8710505e2cecf8a56b574168e3399d9b enforced by assert_frozen_cases with stable reason code CASE_SET_DRIFT (any addition/removal/rewording/reorder/outcome-flip changes the digest and is refused); import-time _assert_internal_consistency fail-closes malformed cases (CASE_MALFORMED) including scenario round-trip through the real DispatchItem/ConsentLedgerView input contracts; unknown ids fail closed (CASE_UNKNOWN). test_privacy_cases.py: 24 tests pass — positive: freeze discipline (deterministic canonical hash equal to the committed constant, unique stable ids, all classes and outcomes covered), every case's expected outcome verified against the real model decision (ALLOW cases carry ALLOWED_ACTIVE_CONSENT with no deletion obligation; DENY cases carry distinct stable reason codes DENY_POST_REVOCATION / PURPOSE_NOT_CONSENTED; INDETERMINATE cases carry LINEAGE_INDETERMINATE and are never counted as safe rejections; post-revocation cases report stored_data='deleted' as an orthogonal surface; OUT_OF_SCOPE/NOT_GUARANTEED cases keep ordinary verdicts with honest orthogonal effects), JSON round-trips of every typed case, semantics clauses cited by cases exist in revocation_semantics(); adversarial: drift refused (added, removed, reworded, reordered, outcome-flipped sets all refused with CASE_SET_DRIFT), no retroactive-erasure claim (semantics refuse retroactive_erasure_of_delivered_bytes and model_memorization_erasure; no case text promises erasure; no ERASE/UNLEARN reason code exists in any decision), no PHI (field vocabulary scanned against the shared kernel PHI_FIELD_MARKERS; no SSN-like identifiers), unknown case id and malformed cases fail closed.
